description: DISCOVERY ONLY: search Roomza's hotel database by city, keyword, or natural language query when the user has NOT named a specific hotel. Understands hotel types (boutique, resort, luxury), vibes (romantic, trendy, quiet), traveler types (couples, families, solo), neighborhoods, and nearby landmarks. Example queries: 'boutique hotels in SoHo', 'romantic resort near the Eiffel Tower', 'pet-friendly hotel in Seattle'. Renders for the user as a full map with a multi-hotel list (so do not repeat the list in prose). NEVER use this when the user names one specific hotel (e.g. 'Wynn Las Vegas'): the map of many hotels is wrong for that. Call get_hotel with the hotel name instead, then get_hotel_rooms and show_rooms.

check_in.description: Check-in date YYYY-MM-DD, when the user gave dates

city.description: Narrow results to a specific city

name: search_hotels

fromNightly.description: Cached nightly from-price in USD; null when uncovered

guestRating.description: Guest score out of 10 from stays booked through the Nuitee network; not part of the Roomza score

guestReviews.description: Number of guest reviews behind guestRating

id.description: Hotel UUID — pass to get_hotel_rooms, get_hotel_pricing, get_nearby, ask_about_hotel

roomCount.description: Rooms tracked on Roomza for this hotel

roomsWithRecords.description: Tracked rooms with at least one verified review

note.description: Search note, e.g. a nearby-city fallback explanation

rooms.description: Single-hotel results only: that hotel's room cards, already shown to the user under the hotel

bookUrl.description: Type cards only: Roomza stay flow with this room type preselected

kind.description: room = a numbered room with a Roomza record; type = a bookable room type at a hotel with no room records yet

photoSource.description: Whether photoUrl shows the actual room or is a hotel-level fallback

priceNote.description: Shown in the price slot when pricePerNight is null, e.g. a prompt to provide dates

pricePerNight.description: Nightly price for the requested dates; null when no dates were given or no live rate exists

stay.description: The dates passed to the search, echoed for the widget

title: Search hotels
